findings.claim: The required canonical OR-01 through OR-23 full-gate JSON artifact is absent from the caller-supplied review material.
findings.observed: The supplied final note, checkpoint, and rollout-readiness document assert that plans/checkpoints/bright-fork-2292.full-gate.json exists and has a particular hash, but the artifact itself was not supplied; therefore its exact ordered unique 23 Green rows, immutable revision and authority bindings, candidate digest integrity, support results, and final schema cannot be inspected.
findings.rationale: Goal-001 specifically requires the canonical full-gate JSON as a deliverable produced by one successful canonical run. Assertions and derived documents cannot substitute for reviewing that required artifact under the caller's review-only-supplied-material constraint.
findings.required: Supply plans/checkpoints/bright-fork-2292.full-gate.json as acceptance material, preserving the generator-produced bytes, so its ordered OR-01 through OR-23 Green results and required integrity bindings can be assessed.
